name: MH03a — No. active on ART and Mental Health treatment during the reporting quarter: Depression and/or Anxiety
description:
Number of clients active on ART with either newly identified or known depression and/or anxiety who received documented mental-health treatment during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have an ART encounter between :startDate and :endDate, satisfy the active-care rule, and have an anxiety_and_or_depression status indicating that treatment was provided. Qualifying treatment states include high suicide risk on medication only, high suicide risk on psychotherapy and medication, known mental illness on psychotherapy only, known mental illness on medication only, and known mental illness on both psychotherapy and medication. Known mental illness NEITHER on Psychotherapy NOR Medication is excluded because no treatment is documented. The available coded responses support these treatment distinctions.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.anxiety_and_or_depression IN (
      'Has signs and symptoms with high suicide Risk on Medication only',
      'Has signs and symptoms with high suicide Risk on Psychotherapy and Medication',
      'Known mental illness on Psychotherapy only',
      'Known mental illness on Medication only',
      'Known mental illness on Psychotherapy and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
